known_issues.summary: A password_hash parameter of the role initializer shows unredacted in system_views.settings
The log and exception text in the generic interface names CassandraRoleManager
PasswordDefaultRoleInitializer is wired to CassandraRoleManager (consistencyForRoleWrite) but AuthConfig does not check the combination
validateConfiguration is a default no-op method; implementations should be forced to decide explicitly, as IRoleManager does
